entry.title: Consulting and contractor panels: Design of Investing in education program
entry.summary:
Watch: Consulting and contractor panels Agency: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade - Australian Aid Program Category: Management advisory services ATM type: Request for Tender Panel arrangement: No Closes: 2026-09-25
The design of the Investing in Education Program will assess and recommend appropriate delivery and implementation arrangements for the program, including consideration of value-for-money, feasibility and sustainably. It will consider implementation approaches that enable future planning, continuation and/or expansion of the investment beyond 2032.
